title: sysctl variables
description: Configuration variables for kernel sysctl.d declarative parameter management

SYSCTL_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install sysctl. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

SYSCTL_VERSION.description: Specific version of sysctl to install.

SYSCTL_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading sysctl binary or archive artifacts.

SYSCTL_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying sysctl available remote releases.

SYSCTL_PARAMS.description: Comma-separated list of kernel key=value parameters rendered into /etc/sysctl.d/<SYSCTL_CONF_NAME>.

SYSCTL_CONF_NAME.description: Drop-in filename written under /etc/sysctl.d/ when staging declarative kernel parameters.
